name: Critical Bad End2 -Defeated Assault Angel-
source:
Assault angel has no longer luck.
There is only a bad end, with no possible recovery.
The hope goes away before the cruel assaults.

Canon reaches at 5 bad ending that she is not fated.
This is a CG image collection with story where no tiny hope is left for the assault angel.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE057392.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
突擊天使已經走投無路了。
只有糟糕的結局，沒有挽回的可能。
在殘酷的襲擊之前，希望就破滅了。

卡農達到了5個壞結局，哪一條都逃不掉。
這是一本對突擊天使不抱一絲希望的故事CG圖集。
